app.tagline: Pack the lander. Run the Moon base. Bring everyone home.
app.title: Pack & Survive
briefing.intro: Commander, you lead a crew of 4 to a base at the Moon's south pole. Survive 30 days! Earth sends one lander. It can carry only {mass} mass units.
briefing.kenji: Kenji talks to you from Mission Control on Earth.
briefing.l1.d: The lander is small. Choose wisely.
briefing.l2.d: Air, water, food and heat all need power.
briefing.l3.d: One spare part can change the ending.
briefing.l4.d: You cannot see it, but it builds up every day.
briefing.title: Mission briefing
common.scientistHint: Shows exact numbers and source links.
item.greenhouse.gives: 2 food + 1 oxygen a day, from day 10
pack.check.cover: Nothing to cover you from a solar storm. A shelter or shield could help.
pack.check.good: Your plan lasts all 30 days if nothing goes wrong. But surprises will happen!
pack.check.hint: A quiet mission with no surprises:
pack.check.night: The base loses power in the dark spell (day {n}).
pack.check.nospare: No spare part: a breakdown would be hard to fix.
pack.hint.dark: Dark spells: days 9-11 and 21-23. Solar panels give nothing then!
pack.mode.easy: Easy mode is on: Radar suggests a cargo.
pack.subtitle: Tap + to add. Stay within the mass limit.
pack.title: Pack the lander
radar.hello: Beep boop! I am Radar, your helper robot.
radar.landing: Landing in 3… 2… 1… Touchdown! Walk around and check on every module.
radar.name: Radar
start.easyHint: Radar suggests a cargo to start with.
start.nobody: Nobody gets hurt. If things go wrong, the crew flies home safe.
